draft.emotion: matter-of-fact and focused on the physical interaction
notes: 押す (osu) is used for pushing or pressing away from you. This is the opposite of 引く (hiku), which means to pull toward you.
Be careful not to confuse 押す with 圧す (also read osu), which is a more formal or kanji-specific way of saying to press or stamp/seal.
